turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Asha, a virtual assistant from Suraksha Health Insurance, calling about the health insurance enquiry you submitted. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Is this a good time to talk for about five minutes?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First, who would you like to cover: just yourself, or also your spouse, children or parents?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the age of the eldest person to be covered?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't know her exact age, not sure

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's fine, we can leave that for the advisor. Which city do you live in?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does anyone to be covered have an existing medical condition, such as diabetes, blood pressure, thyroid or asthma?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't know, I'd have to ask her

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's fine, we can leave that for the advisor. Do you have any existing health insurance, including cover from your employer?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one: which cover amount are you looking at, 5, 10, 15 or 25 lakh rupees? You can also say not sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. I don't have all the details yet, so an advisor will call you back within 2 working days to complete them. Thank you, goodbye.
